div.div:
A Local interactive loop (the default path)
The agent runs in the repo (Claude Code). It pushes,
runs preview-iterate watch, and on failed reads the
structured reason, fixes, and re-pushes — a human
can drive the identical loop.

div.div:
B Autonomous CI loop (wired, @claude)
preview-agent.yml runs claude-code-action on a
PR comment / trigger, unattended, with iteration +
